title: Specify and test bounded credential-stream reconnect
description: Current stream-loss behavior fails closed and relies on Kubernetes restart; no in-process reconnect is implemented.
acceptance_criteria: Bounded backoff and stop semantics tested; expired cached credentials never become current; shutdown leaves no listener or timer.
notes: Quorum run 20261007T123322520415Z confirms restart-only recovery in the selected fetcher. Existing tests deliberately refuse cached credentials after stream termination. Reject the research proposal to serve stale/cached credentials during failure as an unapproved change to the trust boundary. Implement bounded reconnect only with deny-until-fresh-valid-credential semantics, cancellation and root-rotation tests; do not silently ignore invalid updates.
close_reason: Implemented in local cdb488a: bounded reconnect through real spiffe gRPC client; fail-closed loss and invalid updates; TLS root overlap/removal, connection expiry/cap, resumption and rotation race checks. 79 tests, types, lint and build passed; nine existing lint warnings. Shared SPIRE lab refresh remains a portfolio gate.
